review_scope: Challenge-specific substantive compliance and submission readiness; not a prediction of organizer acceptance or score
earlier_completion_scope: Historical completion-audit.json concerned user-authorized local prototype and review package; it is not proof that all competition submission expectations or later English recordings were met.

requirements.requirement: Open-source or managed Omnigent orchestrates live specialist agents exchanging outputs and using tools
requirements.limitation: Historical automatic workflow required engineering changes and explicit recovery messages; new English live workflow has not run.

requirements.requirement: Ambitious scientific question and meaningful reproducible result; hypotheses, two costed candidates, evidence changes next decision
requirements.limitation: Eight matched trials of one simple cooling-sign task. Seven submit one candidate only, so their successful correction precedes feedback from the tested log mechanism. Negative/inconclusive findings are legitimate, but this is weak evidence about diagnostic usefulness and not a physical discovery.

requirements.requirement: Meaningful bottleneck, measurable progress, reported improvement and justified next experiment; no 10x proof required
requirements.limitation: Manual human 813.986s/6 UI actions and Codex automatic 2293.816s/10 native inputs use different operators and infrastructure maturity. Automatic total actions/setup unknown. Cannot infer speedup or reduced total human effort.

requirements.requirement: Citations, hypotheses labeled, uncertainty, controls, source evidence and reproducibility
requirements.limitation: Analysis status omits attempts; incomplete early token attribution and one pilot request. Temperature/seed controls unavailable. Fresh extraction reuses dependencies, not a clean external end-to-end installation. Fresh-host scripts embed a local host ID.

requirements.requirement: Human approval boundaries and responsible claims
requirements.limitation: Isolation was tested on synthetic paths, not universally proved. Dedicated safety agent is suggested, not explicitly mandatory; current tool policies enforce boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Repository, specs/policies, two-minute demo, evidence, code/results, measured improvement and next experiment
requirements.limitation: Existing video is a silent Chinese saved-evidence walkthrough. Requested English live Product Demo and Technical Walkthrough have scripts only. Current ZIP predates these additions. PDF specifies a two-minute demo, not two separate mandatory one-minute videos. Official submission form requirements and deadline are not supplied or verified; no publication/submission authorized.

priorities_before_claiming_submission_re: Stabilize nested agent completion and show the actual English Omnigent workflow with interventions disclosed.
Strengthen the minimal diagnostic-sensitive physical modeling case and expose trial-level attempt/log evidence to Analyst; no large ablation required.
Measure the selected bottleneck with a defined operator/action boundary; report any real automation progress without unsupported causal speed claim.
Record both English one-minute segments, preserve full live footage, refresh the review package and verify official submission logistics.
